tasks.title: Ladder math module: geometry, short-first naming, sign pair, band, quote validity
tasks.description: Create the pure, Qt-free services/option_ladder.py holding every option-geometry and arithmetic decision (20-wide ladder from one offset formula, short-leg-first naming with the fixture guard, the displayed/credit sign pair, the tick-derived band, the quote-validity screen, distance, net greeks, snapping and window legs) and cover it with tests/test_d65_option_ladder.py. No search and no stepping live here: the seed is the engine's (P23-T7) and the walk is the engine's window step (P23-T8).
acceptance_criteria: Given an anchor short strike A, When ladder_pairs(A) is evaluated, Then each side yields exactly four 20-wide spreads whose both legs are offset from the anchor rung by the single offset table {1: +10, 2: +5, 3: 0, 4: -5} applied identically on both sides (one formula, never a mirrored table), SPREAD_WIDTH == 20 and STRIKE_STEP == 5, and the canonical fixtures are CCS 7425/7445 (short below long) and PCS 7340/7320 (short above long).

Given a symbol, an expiry and a (short, long) strike pair, When format_instrument renders a row name, Then it reads `SPX Nov17 7425/7445` with the SHORT leg first and a width of exactly 20 points, and the module's fixture-convention guard rejects any pair that is not 20 wide and any PCS pair whose long strike is above its short - so 7425/7435 (10-wide) and 7315/7435 (inverted PCS) are rejected while the legal 20-wide 7435/7455 is accepted.

Given one long leg and one short leg with quoted bid/ask, When display_bases and credit_bases are evaluated, Then display_bases returns (long.ask - short.bid, long.bid - short.ask) as (display_ask, display_bid), credit_bases returns their exact negatives as (credit_bid, credit_ask, credit_mid) with credit_mid their mean, so a credit pair renders negative by design, and these two helpers are the only place in the module where a sign is decided (the ASK cell pairs with credit_bid, the BID cell with credit_ask).

Given a Target T, When option_tick(T) and match_band(T) are evaluated, Then option_tick returns 0.05 for T = 1.00 and T = 2.95 and 0.10 for T = 3.00 and above, and match_band(T) == max(0.05, option_tick(T)) at every level - both levels pinned at T = 1.00, 2.95 and 3.00.

Given a leg's bid/ask and its per-side received flags, When usable_quote(bid, ask, received_bid, received_ask) screens them, Then a received 0 bid is usable, and -1, 1.7976931348623157e+308, NaN, +/-inf, an unreceived side and bid > ask each report the side absent (None); a one-sided leg returns (None, None) so no pair can be scored or matched on one side.

Given credit bases and a Target, When distance and net_greeks are evaluated, Then distance is min(|credit_mid - T|, |credit_ask - T|, |credit_bid - T|) computed on the credit bases only (never on the displayed negative values) and net_greeks returns long - short for delta and for gamma independently, with a None side propagating as None rather than as a number.

Given a listed strike grid and an anchor, When snap_rung, window_legs and the cell formatters run, Then snap_rung returns a listed strike (an equidistant tie resolves to the strike nearer the anchor) or None when no listed 20-wide pair exists, window_legs(anchor_short) returns the eight LegKey legs of the four-rung window, LegKey and SpreadRow carry exactly the fields the engine and the panel consume, and ASK/BID format to 2 dp, Delta to 3 dp and Gamma to 4 significant digits.

tasks.title: Spread engine A: seeding by measurement, quote validity, band and anchor selection
tasks.description: Create the pure, Qt-free and ibapi-free services/option_spread_engine.py first half: the state machine that finds the anchor by measurement (session anchor, else a bounded coarse probe with leased pairs, then a 5-point refine), scores only pairs whose legs actually quote, and emits lease/subscribe/cancel/release actions, rows and once-only messages. Testable with no Qt, no window and no network; the walk, lifecycle and error classes are P23-T8's second half of the same module.
acceptance_criteria: Given the engine switched ON with today's SPXW chain, When the seed runs, Then it follows the three tiers in order - the session anchor for today's expiry when this session already produced one (no probe lease at all), otherwise at most six coarse probe pairs per side spaced 20 points (each pair leased against free capacity, scored, then released immediately) interpolated to the nearest 5-point rung, then a 5-point refine by window steps - and every seed branch reaches the same final rung against the same chain.

Given a seed in progress, Then the sweep terminates within 10 s wall clock or 12 SCORED pairs, whichever comes first; on the bound the ladder stays at the best-known pair, exactly one message names the bound and the value, and the seed re-arms only at the next cadence evaluation - asserted against an injected clock, never a real sleep.

Given a leg with no tick, When 3 s elapse, Then that leg is pending with its cells showing no value and its pair is not scored and not match-eligible, and it becomes eligible only once BOTH legs of the pair quote; a pair is never scored or matched on one side, and a received zero bid is a live price that still renders and scores.

Given leg quotes, Then a sentinel (-1, 1.7976931348623157e+308, a no-tick zero, NaN, +/-inf) or an unreceived side is absent, never enters the distance computation, and a good value turning sentinel makes the cell empty and the pair ineligible on the next evaluation.

Given credit bases and a Target, Then the anchor is the listed 20-wide pair minimising d = min(|credit_mid - T|, |credit_ask - T|, |credit_bid - T|) computed on the CREDIT bases (never on the displayed negative values), ties break in order (smaller |credit_mid - T|, then credit_mid >= T, then the short strike nearer the underlying's last price with the lower short strike winning when no price exists), and each tie-break is reachable through the seed ladder.
Given a Target, Then the band gating match and movement is h = max(0.05, option_tick(T)) - 0.05 at T = 1.00 and 2.95, 0.10 at T = 3.00 - and the engine never derives a band from a quote.

Given every emitted action sequence, Then each action is one of lease/subscribe/cancel/release, the live option-line count never exceeds 16 at any emitted step (dipping to 14 mid-step is allowed), no action ever leases or subscribes a leg the live window already holds, and each selection cause (no-0DTE, chain edge, rung shortfall, budget refusal, seed bound) latches exactly one message.
